verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export capability. The CSV evidence covers catalog import into Stripe, not export out of it. Listing CheckoutSessions via the API is a developer building block, and ACP/MPP being open protocols is an adjacent feature; neither is a documented way to export all account data in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
